text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help Zenno Rob Roy change her mood 
since she was in a slump, we came to the 
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's so quiet. The city's hustle and 
bustle feels far away... The air feels so 
crisp and clear.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even old local history documents mention 
the purity of the air around this area."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's said to be thanks to the “dragon 
avatar that purifies all defilement”... 
and that's that sacred tree over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The giant tree towering beside the 
shrine... It truly possesses the imposing 
presence of a dragon.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...There is a legend passed down: 'Reach 
the Dragon's Seat in a single breath from 
the mortal realm, and the haze clouding 
the seeker's heart shall be dispelled.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In other words, sprint up the hill to the 
shrine without resting, and offer a prayer 
to the sacred tree. Supposedly, doing so 
purifies the mind.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it is also said that 'if one 
fails, an even deeper dreg takes root 
within the heart'..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit scary, but... If it goes well, 
she might get her groove back...
choice_data_list: I have a feeling you can do it.
I have a feeling you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... ...Yes, I'll give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy went down to the bottom of 
the stairs. Taking a deep breath, she 
sprinted up all at once!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah---!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy dashed all the way up the 
stairs without stopping to catch her 
breath...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant* *pant*... ...I did 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, and next is praying at the sacred 
tree――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a weight has been lifted from 
my chest...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I really feel like the dragon from the 
legend purified everything...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy smiled brightly. It seems 
she was able to regain her stride!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Kya!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh no...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"To think a cat would jump out from the 
bushes... I'm so glad I managed to stop 
before hitting it."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Still... failing leaves a sediment in 
your heart... ...Th-That's just a 
superstition, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because our visit to the sacred 
tree fell through, Zenno Rob Roy's 
condition didn't improve...
